pages.text: The list of items next to your inventory is $(l)JEI$(). It knows every item in the pack.$(br2)Hover an item and press:$(li)$(l)R$() to see how to make it$(li)$(l)U$() to see what it is used for

Type in the search bar at the bottom of JEI to find anything.$(br2)$(l)Jade$() shows the name and mod of whatever you look at, at the top of your screen.$(br2)Hold $(l)Shift$() over items for extra info.
